title: @dogtrax also want to thank @edublogs for their general interest in #IndieWeb. Dream of a day they add native support for themes like SemPress and all
summary: @dogtrax also want to thank @edublogs for their general interest in #IndieWeb. Dream of a day they add native support for themes like SemPress and all the IndieWeb plugins. I get so many requests from people trying to #IndieWeb their Edublogs sites.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax also want to thank @edublogs for their general interest in #IndieWeb. Dream of a day they add native support for themes like SemPress and all the IndieWeb plugins.

I get so many requests from people trying to #IndieWeb their Edublogs sites.
